summary.en: Cadastro de Pessoas Físicas, the 11-digit Brazilian individual taxpayer number, ending in two mod-11 check digits.
summary.pt-BR: Cadastro de Pessoas Físicas, o número de 11 dígitos do contribuinte pessoa física, terminado em dois dígitos verificadores por módulo 11.

format.summary: Formats a given CPF (Cadastro de Pessoas Físicas) value according to the Brazilian standard.
description: - `options.pad` left-pads the value with zeros to 11 digits first.
- `options.obfuscate` hides the first 3 digits and the 2 check digits with `*`, after padding.
- Pending decision (findings §2 #2, #3): the reference (JS) masks an incomplete value as far as it goes and returns an empty string for empty or garbage input; other libs return null.

generate.summary: Generates a valid random CPF (Cadastro de Pessoas Físicas).
description: Generates a valid random CPF: 11 digits, unformatted.
- `state` (a state code such as `SP`) fixes the 9th digit, the região fiscal, to that state's code; without it, or with an unknown code, the digit is random.

tests.name: generated-is-valid
tests.note: every generated value must pass the lib's own validator

isValid.summary: Validates if a CPF (Cadastro de Pessoas Físicas) is valid. Accepts the usual mask characters (`.`, `-`) and whitespace around and between groups.
description: Validates a CPF: 9 base digits and 2 modulus 11 check digits (REGRA_VALIDA_CPF of the Receita Federal).
- A reserved number (all 11 digits the same, e.g. `00000000000`) is rejected.
- Empty, blank or non-numeric input is invalid.
- Pending decision (findings §2 #1): the reference (JS) ignores the mask characters (`.`, `-`) and whitespace around and between groups; other libs accept digits only.
